name: Release v2.4.1 🌈
body:
## 🔐 Security

- **Databricks JDBC connections** — Validated Databricks datasource URLs and connected through the Databricks driver directly, so non-Databricks JDBC URLs are rejected. ([#42244](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42244))
- Updated `netty-handler` from 4.1.136 to 4.1.137 to address CVE-2026-75595. ([#42217](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42217))
- Validated WHERE-clause column names in UQI filtering so untrusted identifiers cannot be used as SQL column names. ([#42224](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42224))
- Used the hardened WebClient builder in AI and Google Sheets plugins. ([#42177](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42177))
- Updated client and server dependencies to address reported vulnerabilities. ([#42214](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42214), [#42173](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42173), [#42218](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42218))

## 🛠️ Reliability

- Prevented OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google AI plugins from loading a conflicting `spring-webflux` copy. That failure could take down AI queries and corrupt the shared Redis connection. ([#42240](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42240))
- Reduced redundant Segment API calls. ([#42216](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42216))

## ✨ New Features & Enhancements

- Added non-interactive `appsmithctl restore` for automation. ([#42147](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42147))

## 🎨 UI & Widget Improvements

- Stopped filing Anvil applications under “AI Agents” and renamed them “responsive”. ([#42219](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42219))

## 🔧 Git, Deployment & Configuration

- MCP server now prefers `APPSMITH_DB_URL` over `APPSMITH_MONGODB_URI` when both are set. ([#42239](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42239))
- Made base-image `apt` installs resilient to transient mirror failures. ([#42221](https://github.com/appsmithorg/appsmith/pull/42221))
